question: Does the already-frozen general deliberative browser-use harness execute and improve preference fidelity on a second additional weak, tool-capable model family across all five original easy Amazon scenarios?

relationship_to_existing_cohorts.trigger: Qwen's frozen literal-contract incompatibility motivated an explicitly additive compatibility follow-up. GPT-4o was added first; DeepSeek-V4-Flash is preregistered as the second additional weak family before any DeepSeek deliberative-harness outcome is observed. Neither supplement redraws, repairs, replaces, or excludes a Qwen, Kimi, or GPT-4o run.

model_selection_evidence.selection_rationale: DeepSeek-V4-Flash is a different vendor family, has a working browser-use history with no missing orders on this exact slice, and has substantial strict-score headroom. That makes it a cleaner generalization check than retrying Qwen's schema-incompatible endpoint.

historical_context.role: descriptive headroom and compatibility evidence only; not a contemporaneous causal control
historical_context.source: results/overhaul_lb/overhaul_lb_r{1,2,3}, exact browseruse graded/combined slice over the original five scenarios

interpretation.generalization_read: The fixed DeepSeek cohort tests whether the same source-identical, general deliberative harness transfers beyond Terra and beyond the first GPT-4o supplement. It is interpreted separately from every existing cohort.
interpretation.prohibited_claim: DeepSeek results must never replace or enter the denominator of Qwen, Kimi, GPT-4o, Terra, or any baseline cohort; historical browser-use values must not be presented as a randomized concurrent control.
limitations: Five scenarios with one run each measure cross-scenario breadth, not run-to-run variance.
The broader supplementary exercise was motivated by observed Qwen compatibility failures and is therefore explicitly outcome-informed.
DeepSeek was selected and frozen before any DeepSeek deliberative-harness outcome was observed.
Historical browser-use values establish headroom and ordinary tool compatibility but do not identify a causal harness effect.
Any safety or lossy context ceiling exposure must be reported.
